rows.grounds: dharma + karma + prabhāva + kṛt, agent effecting their power

items.question: What qualities characterize the sky-going deity who effects the power of dharma and karma?
premises: The deity effects dharma and karma power.
items.inference: Thus the deity is supportless, sky-going, and power-effecting.
uncertainties: Case and gender inferred from surrounding verse context.
items.plain_english: Supportless, sky-going, effecting the power of dharma and karma.
